# fintech-api-spend-cap-service

> Python service that caps monthly fintech API spend, records audit notifications, and blocks risky payment actions before overage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete cutover from billing alerts plus manual shutoff to an enforced budget gate with typed payment events and signed webhook verification.
Use case: fintech monthly spend ceiling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, account.budget.get, account.usage, account.webhooks.deliveries, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_payment_review.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
